classes.description: A real active worker assigned to a department/floor with a real task.
A worker in Training Academy or simulation mode.
A worker inside Recruitment Agency, not active yet.
rules: not yet assigned to operational floor

classes.description: A worker stationed in Rest/Dormitory; idle but available for shift change.
A worker removed from active duty due to discipline.
A worker that exists in old registries but is not reporting.
rules: status not in (active, reporting, training) OR reporting_enabled=false

classes.description: An aggregate visual marker, not a worker.
rules: never a worker_id; used only by the renderer for count badges

policy: External tower view shows per-floor COUNT BADGES only — never individual labels for every worker. Individual worker rows are only rendered inside the floor inspector for the selected floor.
